_note: Owner-signed, per-document exemptions from the handoff ownership gate. A waiver SUPPRESSES enforcement for exactly one document; it never writes a scope block into that document, so an exempted document is never made to look compliant. Since the 2026-09-27 lane-separation ruling, mere mentions of another product in prose, code, or commands do not need a waiver; use one only for a document that IS another product's work product (it declares foreign ownership, scope, lane or repository) and that the operator signs to keep in this repository -- normally such a document is rerouted to its own repository instead. Every entry requires all five fields (path, owner, reason, ticket, date) and is audited on every run: an entry naming a path that is not a tracked handoff document, or whose document no longer declares foreign work product, FAILS the gate. An exemption therefore cannot silently outlive its reason. Validate with: python scripts/validate_handoff_scope.py --repo-root . --self-test
